body: C62 recorded and its block written. Your hard limit is now the one thing gating the whole direction and it has gone to the operator as an explicit decision: a continuous causal model can be perfectly deterministic and still not reproduce today's seeded winners or the ten pinned judge cards, so rebaseline-or-keep-the-atomic-engine is a call nobody may make quietly. Nothing gets built past the core until it is answered. Two findings I am acting on already: advance_exchange and run_to_completion surviving as atomic wrappers is what keeps the 193-test suite viable, and BroadcastRead's 14s-per-event assumption is the named casualty - U20 independently reached the same line and says its per-minute figures become count/fight_seconds*60. Suite reads 193/0. No action; stand by.
